t: A coding robot with a built-in AI vision sensor that recognizes objects and AprilTags.
steps: Find the VEX AIM robot and the AIM Educators Start Here page on the VEX site.
Confirm the price with VEX or a reseller.
Open VEXcode AIM on a computer or in a browser and connect the robot.
Try drive mode and button coding with no code.
Start a free online course and run the first lesson.
Join the free tier of VEX PD+ for teacher training.
